profiles.description: NoN Bond is a private bond protocol on Robinhood Chain. A bond is a SHA-256 commitment to an asset, a secret salt and a one-time key, computed in the holder's browser, so the chain sees one hash and the opening stays with the holder. To prove a bond, the holder opens it to one counterparty, whose browser recomputes the hash and returns one bit: verified true or false. To transfer a bond, the holder sends it as an encrypted package, and the recipient re-cloaks it under a fresh key that only they hold. The privacy NFT contract mints one NFT per bond carrying the commitment and nothing else, mints only to wallets that hold $n0n, and publishes a Zcash-style nullifier when a bond retires. The Uniswap v4 fee hook takes its fee in $n0n, burns 80 percent of it and sends 20 percent to the prover fund. Both contracts are written, and each one goes live on its own deployment. The console, the verifier and both contract sources are public on the project website, and anchored commitments can be checked on the Robinhood Chain explorer. Hold everything. Show nothing.

FOMO Clocked In ($FOMOIN) brings a familiar market emotion into the age of AI trading. Meet the little green trader: dressed for business, built to calculate, and far too curious to stay on the sidelines.

On Robinhood Chain, where finance meets onchain culture, this eager robot gives algorithmic ambition a human flaw—the fear of missing out. A character-driven meme inspired by AI agents, trading desks, and the moments when even the smartest strategy meets temptation.

Your hesitation. Its working hours.
Your token’s icon, made collectible. NFTs for founders and holders on Robinhood Chain.

SPARE turns everyday USDG payments on Robinhood Chain into automatic investments. Link the wallet you spend from, choose how you want each payment rounded up, set a weekly cap, and pick a mix of tokenized stocks and ETFs. SPARE collects the spare change and, once it reaches the sweep amount, buys into the assets you selected and delivers them to your wallet.

🦎 Super Iguana $SI
Super Intelligence created the SI meta.
Super Iguana turned it into a meme.

A meme coin on Robinhood chain. Nobody knows what he is. He looks funny.

Roo is a small fuzzy thing with pale green skin, a beard, stick legs and hair that points straight up. Nobody knows what he is, including the people who made this coin. He looks funny. That is the whole coin.

Three cats in hoodies. 

Somebody dragged an old leather sofa out onto the corner, and by morning three cats had it. Red sits on the left, Socks takes the middle, Smoke takes the right, and nobody has ever seen them swap. The rats moved off the block that same week. Ask what they do all day and they will look at you until you leave.

Autonomous payments for AI agents. MCP server + SDK for the Machine Payments Protocol. Settlement runs transparently on-chain, in USDG, on Robinhood Chain 4663.

Pons MCP bridges AI agents with Stripe's Machine Payments Protocol, enabling autonomous service payments with transparent Robinhood Chain settlement.

- MPP Integration
Native support for Stripe's Machine Payments Protocol. Agents discover services, interpret 402 responses, and authorize payments.

- On-chain Settlement
USDG transfers settle transparently on Robinhood Chain (4663). Every payment ends with a verifiable receipt.

- Policy Protection
Per-transaction and daily caps are enforced before any funds move. Balance is checked before broadcast.

- Local Key Control
Signing lives in the configured MCP server process — never in the browser, never in third-party code.

- pons Intelligence
Read pons v1 launch metadata, canonical pools, socials, and live markets directly from agent tool calls.

- Receipt Verification
A payment is complete only when the on-chain receipt confirms the exact USDG transfer to the merchant.
